BEFORE invoking, check if the question is specific enough to research directly — if underspecified (e.g., "what car to buy" without budget/use-case/region), ask 2-3 clarifying questions to narrow scope. Then pass the refined question as args, weaving the answers in.
- dataviz: Use this skill whenever you are about to create ANY chart, graph, plot, dashboard, or data visualization, in ANY output medium — an HTML or React artifact, inline SVG, plotting code in any library (matplotlib, plotly, d3, Recharts, …), an image/PNG you will render and upload, or a chart shared into Slack. Read it BEFORE writing the first line of chart code, choosing chart colors, building a stat tile / meter / KPI row, or laying out a dashboard. Produces visualizations that read as one system — elegant, accessible, consistent in light and dark — using a brand-neutral placeholder palette you swap for your own. Teaches a design-system-agnostic method: a form heuristic, a color formula with a runnable validator, mark specs, and interaction rules. A validated default palette is documented in `references/palette.md` — swap that file's values for your brand's. Triggers on: "chart", "graph", "plot", "data viz", "visualization", "dashboard", "analytics", "visualize data", "categorical colors", "sequential / diverging palette", "stat tile", "sparkline", "heatmap", "legend", "axis", "tooltip", "chart colors", "color by series".
- artifact-design: Design guidance and fundamentals for Artifacts.
- update-config: Use this skill to configure the Claude Code harness via settings.json. Automated behaviors ("from now on when X", "each time X", "whenever X", "before/after X") require hooks configured in settings.json - the harness executes these, not Claude, so memory/preferences cannot fulfill them. Also use for: permissions ("allow X", "add permission", "move permission to"), env vars ("set X=Y"), hook troubleshooting, or any changes to settings.json/settings.local.json files. Examples: "allow npm commands", "add bq permission to global settings", "move permission to user settings", "set DEBUG=true", "when claude stops show X". For simple settings like theme/model, suggest the /config command.
- keybindings-help: Use when the user wants to customize keyboard shortcuts, rebind keys, add chord bindings, or modify ~/.claude/keybindings.json. Examples: "rebind ctrl+s", "add a chord shortcut", "change the submit key", "customize keybindings".
- verify: Verify that a code change actually does what it's supposed to by exercising it end-to-end and observing behavior — drive the affected flow, not just tests or typecheck. Run before committing nontrivial changes; bootstraps this repo's project verify skill if none exists yet. Don't invoke it on a diff that only touches tests, docs, or other code with no runtime surface to drive (a change to product source always has one) — there's nothing to observe.
- code-review: Review the current diff for correctness bugs and reuse/simplification/efficiency cleanups at the given effort level (low/medium: fewer, high-confidence findings; high→max: broader coverage, may include uncertain findings). Pass --comment to post findings as inline PR comments, or --fix to apply the findings to the working tree after the review.
- simplify: Review the changed code for reuse, simplification, efficiency, and altitude cleanups, then apply the fixes. Quality only — it does not hunt for bugs; use /code-review for that.
- fewer-permission-prompts: Scan your transcripts for common read-only Bash and MCP tool calls, then add a prioritized allowlist to project .claude/settings.json to reduce permission prompts.
- loop: Run a prompt or slash command on a recurring interval (e.g. /loop 5m /foo). Omit the interval to let the model self-pace. - When the user wants to set up a recurring task, poll for status, or run something repeatedly on an interval (e.g. "check the deploy every 5 minutes", "keep running /babysit-prs"). Do NOT invoke for one-off tasks.
- schedule: Create, update, list, or run scheduled cloud agents (routines) that execute on a cron schedule. - When the user wants to schedule a recurring cloud agent, set up automated tasks, create a cron job for Claude Code, or manage their scheduled agents/routines. Also use when the user wants a one-time scheduled run ("run this once at 3pm", "remind me to check X tomorrow").
- claude-api: Reference for the Claude API / Anthropic SDK — model ids, pricing, params, streaming, tool use, MCP, agents, caching, token counting, model migration.
TRIGGER — read BEFORE opening the target file; don't skip because it "looks like a one-liner" — whenever: the prompt names Claude/Anthropic in any form (Claude, Anthropic, Fable, Opus, Sonnet, Haiku, `anthropic`, `@anthropic-ai`, `claude-*`, `us.anthropic.*`, `[1m]`); the user asks about an LLM (pricing/model choice/limits/caching) — never answer from memory; OR the task is LLM-shaped with provider unstated (agent/MCP/tool-definition/multi-agent/RAG/LLM-judge/computer-use; generate/summarize/extract/classify/rewrite/converse over NL; debugging refusals/cutoffs/streaming/tool-calls/tokens).

- run: Launch and drive this project's app to see a change working. Use when asked to run, start, or screenshot the app, or to confirm a change works in the real app (not just tests). First looks for a project skill that already covers launching the app; otherwise falls back to built-in patterns per project type (CLI, server, TUI, Electron, browser-driven, library).

content.content: 1 # -*- coding: utf-8 -*- 2 """ 3 ERP（赛狐 Sellfox）操作：订单 > 订单处理（订单发货） 4 === 第一步：物流下单（对应视频前 50 多秒）=== 5 在【待处理】视图，(可选)按渠道筛选 -> 全选订单 -> 点击【物流下单】把订单投入海外仓 6 -> 读取结果弹窗「成功X 失败Y」(失败常见：所选仓库库存不足)。 7 DRY_RUN=True 时：完成 切视图/筛选/全选/统计，但【不】点击"物流下单"，只记录将处理的订单数。 8 9 其它阶段(审核通过/确认发货/获取跟踪单号)见后续，同样受 DRY_RUN 保护。 10 """ 11 import re, time 12 import config, core 13 from core import log 14 15 16 # ---------------- 打开与导航 ---------------- 17 def open_order_ship(page): 18 core.safe_goto(page, config.ERP_URL) 19 for _ in range(30): 20 time.sleep(1) 21 if page.query_selector(".el-table") or page.query_selector("text=订单处理"): 22 break 23 time.sleep(2) 24 dismiss_alert_modal(page) 25 26 27 def dismiss_alert_modal(page): 28 """关闭落地时弹出的「订单异常提醒」等拦截弹窗（点 稍后处理/关闭），避免挡住后续操作。""" 29 for _ in range(3): 30 closed = False 31 for t in ["稍后处理", "关 闭", "关闭", "我知道了", "取 消", "取消"]: 32 b = page.query_selector(f".el-dialog:visible button:has-text('{t}'), .el-message-box:visible button:has-text('{t}')") 33 if b and b.is_visible(): 34 try: 35 b.click(); closed = True; time.sleep(1) 36 except Exception: 37 pass 38 break 39 if not closed: 40 break 41 42 43 def dismiss_notifications(page): 44 """清掉右上角 el-notification toast（如"下载中心"通知）。它是浮层，会盖在筛选框/按钮上 45 拦截 Playwright 点击（intercepts pointer events），直接从 DOM 移除最稳。""" 46 try: 47 page.evaluate("() => document.querySelectorAll('.el-notification').forEach(e => e.remove())") 48 except Exception: 49 pass 50 51 52 def goto_view(page, name): 53 """点击左侧导航切换视图，如 '待处理' / '待审核'。""" 54 try: 55 page.click(f"text={name}", timeout=6000) 56 time.sleep(3) 57 log(f"[ERP] 切换到视图：{name}") 58 return True 59 except Exception as e: 60 log(f"[ERP] 切换视图 {name} 失败: {e}") 61 return False 62 63 64 def report_counts(page): 65 labels = ["待审核", "待处理", "自营仓库", "三方仓", "有货", "缺货", "已发货", "已搁置", "异常处理"] 66 result = {} 67 for lb in labels: 68 try: 69 el = page.query_selector(f"text={lb}") 70 num = None 71 if el: 72 parent = el.evaluate_handle("e=>e.parentElement") 73 txt = page.evaluate("e=>e.innerText", parent) 74 m = re.findall(r"\d+", txt or "") 75 num = m[-1] if m else None 76 result[lb] = num 77 except Exception: 78 result[lb] = None 79 log(f"[ERP] 阶段统计: {result}") 80 return result 81 82 83 # ---------------- 渠道筛选（可选） ---------------- 84 def filter_by_channel(page, channel_keyword): 85 """在「全部渠道」多选弹层里选中 == channel_keyword 的渠道并确定。channel_keyword=None 不筛选。 86 实测：触发控件 input[placeholder*='渠道']；渠道选项是 span.main_label（精确匹配文本， 87 别用包含匹配——订单行 物流信息列 也含渠道文字会误点）；弹层有 取消/确定。""" 88 if not channel_keyword: 89 return True 90 try: 91 dismiss_notifications(page) # 先清右上角通知浮层，否则会拦截点击 92 page.click("input[placeholder*='渠道']", timeout=5000, force=True) 93 time.sleep(1.2) 94 picked = False 95 for el in page.query_selector_all("span.main_label"): 96 try: 97 if el.is_visible() and (el.inner_text() or "").strip() == channel_keyword: 98 el.click(); picked = True 99 log(f"[ERP] 渠道选中: {channel_keyword}") 100 break 101 except Exception: 102 continue 103 if not picked: 104 # 打出下拉里【实际可选】的渠道，便于判断是「该渠道确实无正常单(模板已排除取消单)」 105 # 还是「有单却漏筛」。需求1 选模板会排除取消/退款/换货/禁处理单，这些渠道可能不再出现。 106 try: 107 avail = page.evaluate(r"""() => [...document.querySelectorAll('span.main_label')] 108 .filter(e=>e.offsetParent!==null).map(e=>(e.innerText||'').trim()).filter(Boolean)""") 109 except Exception: 110 avail = [] 111 log(f"[ERP] 未找到渠道选项: {channel_keyword}；当前下拉可选渠道={sorted(set(avail))}") 112 try: page.keyboard.press("Escape") 113 except Exception: pass 114 return False 115 time.sleep(0.5) 116 # 确定（限可见弹层） 117 for t in ["确定", "确认"]: 118 b = page.query_selector(f".el-popper:visible button:has-text('{t}')") 119 if not (b and b.is_visible()): 120 b = page.query_selector(f"button:has-text('{t}'):visible") 121 if b and b.is_visible(): 122 b.click(); break 123 time.sleep(2.5) 124 return True 125 except Exception as e: 126 log(f"[ERP] 渠道筛选失败: {e}") 127 return False 128 129 130 # ---------------- 筛选模板（需求1，用户 2026-07-10）---------------- 131 # 物流下单选渠道后加一步：选「筛选模板」= 未取消等待发货 132 # （该模板含 退款订单/换货订单/申请取消/禁止处理 全=否，排除已取消/退款/换货/禁处理的单）。 133 # 模板列表里另有「单品单件未取消待发货」，业务定用前者。 134 FILTER_TEMPLATE = "未取消等待发货" 135 136 137 def select_filter_template(page, template_name=FILTER_TEMPLATE): 138 """点工具栏「筛选模板」下拉 -> 弹层左侧模板名称列表里点选 template_name（点击模板名称即选中）。 139 实测(截图 新需求.docx image1/2)：按钮文本『筛选模板』；弹层左列是模板名称，右侧悬停看详情。 140 ⚠️ 待实测确认：选模板会不会重置已选的渠道筛选（截图里包裹数 2->5、渠道 chip 疑消失）。 141 故本函数只负责『选中模板』；渠道是否被重置由调用方在选后校验（见 place_logistics_orders）。 142 返回 True/False。""" 143 if not template_name: 144 return True 145 try: 146 dismiss_notifications(page) 147 # 打开「筛选模板」下拉（可能是 span/div 文本触发，不一定是 button） 148 opened = False 149 for sel in ("text=筛选模板", ":text('筛选模板')"): 150 try: 151 page.click(sel, timeout=4000) 152 opened = True 153 break 154 except Exception: 155 continue 156 if not opened: 157 log("[ERP] 未找到『筛选模板』触发控件") 158 return False 159 time.sleep(1.2) 160 # 弹层里精确匹配模板名称文本并点击（精确匹配，避免误点『单品单件未取消待发货』） 161 picked = False 162 for el in page.query_selector_all( 163 ".el-popper:visible *, .el-popover:visible *, .el-dropdown-menu:visible *"): 164 try: 165 if not el.is_visible(): 166 continue 167 if (el.inner_text() or "").strip() == template_name: 168 el.click() 169 picked = True 170 break 171 except Exception: 172 continue 173 if not picked: 174 # 兜底：不限定弹层，全页精确文本匹配（仍精确，排除行内） 175 for el in page.query_selector_all("span, div, li, a"): 176 try: 177 if el.is_visible() and (el.inner_text() or "").strip() == template_name: 178 el.click(); picked = True; break 179 except Exception: 180 continue 181 if not picked: 182 log(f"[ERP] 未找到筛选模板选项：{template_name}") 183 try: page.keyboard.press("Escape") 184 except Exception: pass 185 return False 186 time.sleep(2) 187 log(f"[ERP] 已选择筛选模板：{template_name}") 188 return True 189 except Exception as e: 190 log(f"[ERP] 选择筛选模板失败: {e}") 191 return False 192 193 194 # ---------------- 选择与下单 ---------------- 195 def _find_toolbar_button(page, text): 196 """定位工具栏批量按钮：文本恰为 text、不在 vxe 表格行内、可见、y 最靠上的那个。 197 返回 elementhandle（用于 Playwright 真实点击）。""" 198 target, ty = None, None 199 for h in page.query_selector_all("button, .el-button, .base_button_comp, .myj-btn, [class*=btn]"): 200 try: 201 if (h.inner_text() or "").replace("　", " ").replace(" ", "").strip() != text: 202 continue 203 if h.evaluate("e=>!!e.closest('.vxe-body--row')"): 204 continue 205 if not h.is_visible(): 206 continue 207 bb = h.bounding_box() 208 if not bb: 209 continue 210 if target is None or bb["y"] < ty: 211 target, ty = h, bb["y"] 212 except Exception: 213 continue 214 return target 215 216 217 218 def count_orders(page): 219 """读取订单总数。订单表是 vxe-table，自定义分页把总数拆成 220 `共 N 条`，故读 .total_style（页面可能有多个分页实例，取最大值）。 221 数据是异步加载的：轮询等待 total>0 或超时。""" 222 for _ in range(5): # 最多 5s：有单基本秒出，0 单最多等 5s 判空（原 20s） 223 try: 224 n = page.evaluate( 225 "() => { const a=[...document.querySelectorAll('.total_style')]" 226 ".map(e=>parseInt((e.innerText||'0').replace(/\\D/g,''),10))" 227 ".filter(x=>!isNaN(x)); return a.length? Math.max(...a):0; }" 228 ) 229 if n and n > 0: 230 return int(n) 231 except Exception: 232 pass 233 time.sleep(1) 234 # 兜底：按去重后的 vxe 行数（固定列会翻倍，用逻辑行组 .parentRowGroup） 235 try: 236 return page.evaluate("() => document.querySelectorAll('.parentRowGroup').length") 237 except Exception: 238 return 0 239 240 241 def select_all(page): 242 """点击 vxe-table 表头全选框，并校验确有行被勾选。""" 243 th = page.query_selector(".vxe-header--column.col--checkbox .vxe-cell--checkbox") 244 if not th: 245 log("[ERP] 未找到 vxe 表头全选框"); return False 246 if "is--disabled" in (th.get_attribute("class") or ""): 247 log("[ERP] 表头全选框禁用（可能无数据）"); return False 248 try: 249 th.click(); time.sleep(1.5) 250 except Exception as e: 251 log(f"[ERP] 全选点击失败: {e}"); return False 252 checked = page.evaluate( 253 "() => document.querySelectorAll('.vxe-body--row.row--checked, .vxe-cell--checkbox.is--checked').length" 254 ) 255 if not checked: 256 log("[ERP] 全选后未检测到勾选行"); return False 257 log(f"[ERP] 已全选，勾选标记数≈{checked}") 258 return True 259 260 261 def parse_result_text(txt): 262 """从结果框文本解析 成功/失败数 与失败订单号。返回 {success,fail,fail_orders,text}。""" 263 if not txt: 264 return {"success": None, "fail": None, "fail_orders": [], "text": ""} 265 ms = re.search(r"成功[:：]?\s*(\d+)", txt) 266 mf = re.search(r"失败[:：]?\s*(\d+)", txt) 267 # 订单/包裹号形如 P2AC6TCD61425（P + 十余位字母数字） 268 orders = re.findall(r"\bP[0-9A-Z]{9,15}\b", txt) 269 # 去掉可能混入的表头等，保留失败区（有失败时才收集） 270 return { 271 "success": int(ms.group(1)) if ms else None, 272 "fail": int(mf.group(1)) if mf else None, 273 "fail_orders": list(dict.fromkeys(orders)), 274 "text": txt, 275 } 276 277 278 def read_result_dialog(page): 279 """读取物流下单后的结果弹窗文本（成功X 失败Y + 原因），解析后关闭。返回 parse 字典。""" 280 txt = None 281 for _ in range(30): 282 dlg = page.query_selector(".el-dialog__wrapper:not([style*='display: none']) .el-dialog, .el-message-box") 283 if dlg: 284 try: txt = (dlg.inner_text() or "").strip() 285 except Exception: pass 286 break 287 time.sleep(1) 288 if txt: 289 log("[ERP] 物流下单结果:\n" + txt[:800]) 290 # 关闭：只在【可见】弹窗内找按钮，且 click 用短超时。 291 # 旧写法 query_selector 不限定可见弹窗、b.click() 用默认 30 秒超时——命中隐藏 el-dialog 292 # 里的同名按钮就会干等满 30 秒，几个候选累计 ~90–120 秒（2026-07-10 日志：全成功也卡 293 # 124s≈4×30、有失败卡 91s≈3×30），这才是“下单后卡在结果页很久”的真因。 294 closed = False 295 for t in ["关 闭", "关闭", "确 定", "确定", "知道了", "ok"]: 296 b = page.query_selector( 297 f".el-dialog__wrapper:not([style*='display: none']) button:has-text('{t}'), " 298 f".el-message-box__wrapper:not([style*='display: none']) button:has-text('{t}')") 299 if b and b.is_visible(): 300 try: 301 b.click(timeout=3000); closed = True; break 302 except Exception: 303 pass 304 if not closed: 305 try: page.keyboard.press("Escape") 306 except Exception: pass 307 time.sleep(1) 308 return parse_result_text(txt) 309 310 311 def place_logistics_orders(page, channel_keyword=None): 312 """ 313 第一步核心：待处理视图 -> (可选渠道筛选) -> 全选 -> 物流下单 -> 读结果。 314 DRY_RUN 下不点击"物流下单"。 315 """ 316 open_order_ship(page) 317 if not goto_view(page, "待处理"): 318 return 319 # 需求1（用户 2026-07-10）：选「筛选模板=未取消等待发货」排除 已取消/退款/换货/禁处理 的单。 320 # ⚠️ 实测(erp_probe_template 2026-07-10)：选模板会【重置渠道筛选】(仅渠道1单->选模板后8单)， 321 # 故必须『先选模板 -> 再筛渠道』：让渠道筛选【最后】生效=下单时渠道范围一定有效(安全底线)， 322 # 且实测再筛渠道后模板的4个条件仍保留(模板∩渠道，C=1单)。模板选择失败不致命—— 323 # 渠道安全底线由下方 filter_by_channel 保证，仅少一层取消单排除，不会造成误发。 324 if not select_filter_template(page): 325 log("[ERP] ⚠️ 筛选模板未选中，继续（渠道筛选仍会保证范围，仅少了取消/退款单的排除）") 326 # 安全底线：指定了渠道就必须筛选成功(且在模板之后)，否则会对未筛选的全量订单下单（跨渠道误发）。 327 if channel_keyword and not filter_by_channel(page, channel_keyword): 328 log(f"[ERP] 渠道筛选未成功({channel_keyword})，为避免全量误下单，跳过本渠道") 329 core.log.event("物流下单", channel=channel_keyword, error="渠道筛选失败跳过", dry_run=config.DRY_RUN) 330 return {"count": 0, "error": "渠道筛选失败", "channel_filter_failed": True} 331 n = count_orders(page) 332 log(f"[ERP] 待处理订单 共 {n} 条" + (f"（渠道过滤: {channel_keyword}）" if channel_keyword else "")) 333 if n == 0: 334 log("[ERP] 无待处理订单"); return {"count": 0, "success": 0, "fail": 0, "fail_orders": []} 335 336 if not select_all(page): 337 log("[ERP] 全选失败，终止物流下单"); return {"count": n, "error": "全选失败"} 338 339 if config.DRY_RUN: 340 log(f"[ERP][DRY] 将点击【物流下单】处理 {n} 条订单（已跳过实际点击）") 341 core.log.event("物流下单", channel=channel_keyword, count=n, dry_run=True) 342 return {"count": n, "dry_run": True} 343 344 # 点"物流下单"。行内也有同名按钮，必须点工具栏批量按钮。 345 # 关键：必须用 Playwright 真实点击(elementhandle.click)，JS 合成 click 不触发 Vue 事件！ 346 btn = _find_toolbar_button(page, "物流下单") 347 if not btn: 348 log("[ERP] 未定位到工具栏【物流下单】按钮"); return {"count": n, "error": "未找到物流下单按钮"} 349 try: 350 btn.click() 351 log(f"[ERP] 已点击工具栏【物流下单】，处理 {n} 条") 352 except Exception as e: 353 log(f"[ERP] 点击物流下单失败: {e}"); return {"count": n, "error": str(e)} 354 time.sleep(3) 355 r = read_result_dialog(page) 356 if r.get("fail"): 357 log(f"[ERP] ⚠️ 物流下单失败 {r['fail']} 单：{r['fail_orders']}") 358 core.log.event("物流下单", channel=channel_keyword, count=n, 359 success=r.get("success"), fail=r.get("fail"), 360 fail_orders=r.get("fail_orders", []), dry_run=False) 361 return {"count": n, "success": r.get("success"), "fail": r.get("fail"), 362 "fail_orders": r.get("fail_orders", []), "result_text": r.get("text")} 363 364 365 # ---------------- 订单状态更新（三方仓>待更新>手动更新，获取跟踪号）---------------- 366 def _toolbar_btn_coord(page, text): 367 """返回工具栏(非行内)中 去空白后文本==text 的按钮中心坐标 {x,y}（取最内层）。无则 None。""" 368 return page.evaluate(r"""(text) => { 369 const norm = s => (s||'').replace(/\s+/g,''); 370 let best=null; 371 document.querySelectorAll('button, .el-button, .base_button_comp, [class*=btn]').forEach(e=>{ 372 if(e.offsetParent===null) return; 373 if(norm(e.innerText)!==text) return; 374 if(e.closest('.vxe-body--row')) return; // 排除行内同名按钮 375 const r=e.getBoundingClientRect(); 376 const desc=e.querySelectorAll('*').length; 377 if(!best || desc 待更新 子标签 -> 工具栏【手动更新】-> 拉取跟踪号 -> 385 读「获取完成 共N包裹 已获取X 失败Y」-> 关闭。不分渠道。返回 {total,got,fail,text}。 386 此操作只拉取/更新状态，不发货，DRY_RUN 也执行（属只读性质的状态同步）。""" 387 open_order_ship(page) 388 # 三方仓 389 try: 390 page.click("text=三方仓", timeout=6000); time.sleep(3) 391 except Exception as e: 392 log(f"[ERP] 进三方仓失败: {e}"); return {"error": "进三方仓失败"} 393 # 待更新 子标签 394 try: 395 page.click("text=待更新", timeout=6000); time.sleep(2.5) 396 except Exception as e: 397 log(f"[ERP] 点待更新子标签失败: {e}"); return {"error": "待更新子标签失败"} 398 399 n = count_orders(page) 400 if not n: 401 log("[ERP] 待更新 0 条，无需状态更新") 402 return {"total": 0, "got": 0, "fail": 0, "text": "待更新为空"} 403 # 手动更新按钮无选中时禁用 -> 先全选（vxe 表头框） 404 if not select_all(page): 405 log("[ERP] 待更新全选失败"); return {"error": "待更新全选失败"} 406 407 loc = _toolbar_btn_coord(page, "手动更新") 408 if not loc: 409 log("[ERP] 未找到【手动更新】按钮") 410 return {"total": n, "got": 0, "fail": 0, "text": "无手动更新按钮"} 411 page.mouse.click(loc["x"], loc["y"]) 412 log(f"[ERP] 已全选 {n} 条并点【手动更新】，拉取跟踪号中…") 413 414 # 轮询提示框直到 获取完成/100% 415 final = None 416 for _ in range(60): 417 time.sleep(1) 418 txt = page.evaluate(r"""() => { 419 const d=[...document.querySelectorAll('.el-dialog, .el-message-box')].find(e=>e.offsetParent!==null); 一个网页里可以嵌套别的网页（iframe）。浏览器控制台每次只能“站在”其中一个网页里执行代码。DevTools 控制台顶部有个小下拉，默认显示 **`top`**（最外层页面），可以切换到某个内嵌页面。之前我担心订单表在某个内嵌 iframe 里，所以让你去切。
